lines.en: I walk over blackstone.
Lava light falls on me.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵已经不太像猪灵
lines.en: My ears are no longer quite a piglin's.
Something else has grown on my gold armour.
My hooves thud on the blackstone.
The ground is hot underfoot.
Even a Nether piglin has been tainted.

lines.zh: 身体一侧的骨节错位了
lines.en: A joint on one side has slipped.
I no longer fiddle with gold.
I have walked the Nether a long while.
I drag my steps across the bridge.
I walk along the lava's edge.
I stand; the lava sounds behind me.
I look down at this hand.
I raise my head slowly.
I once lived better than this.
I stand against the blackstone.
There is sulphur in my breath.
I am no longer afraid of lava.
I turn halfway around.
Hot wind blows through my armour.
I touch my own face.

lines.zh: 你身上没有金子的味道
lines.en: You do not smell of gold.
I lift my head toward you.
You are standing on this side of the lava.

lines.zh: 你手里没有金子，我犹豫了。
lines.en: No gold in your hands — I hesitate.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处发着光
lines.en: My eyes glow in the dark.
I lift my chin at you.
You are a little shorter than me.
The heat here is bad for you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把重心换到另一条腿
lines.en: I shift my weight to the other leg.
The bridge behind you is narrow.
A dent in my armour.
I step back and slip.

lines.zh: 我的身体有一处不对劲
lines.en: Something in my body is wrong.
I grit my teeth hard.
Something clicked in my bones.

lines.zh: 下界的火，改不了我多少。
lines.en: Nether fire does not change me much.
That only irritates me.
Hot wind on the wound, burning.

lines.zh: 我捂着肋，鼻孔喷出白气。
lines.en: I clutch my ribs, white breath snorting.

lines.zh: 下界的我，连金子都不看了。
lines.en: Nether-born, I no longer even look at gold.
Gold no longer matters to me.
But this has some smell to it.
I put my hand out.
Gold? Useless to me long ago.
I have it in my hand.
I do not know why I took it.
This is far from enough.

lines.zh: 下界的金子在掌心发烫。
lines.en: Nether gold burns in my palm.
I squeeze it in my hand.
Do you have anything else?
You struck my gold armour.
I held, and the gold held.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的骨头响了
lines.en: That made my bones creak.
I turn and let you past.
This ledge is too narrow.
I step back and nearly slip.
We are pressed together.
Do not touch what is in my seams.
This is not the time for a fight.
Steady; there is lava below.
I remember things from before.

lines.zh: 我以前会拿金子换东西
lines.en: I used to trade gold for things.
Now only this armour is left.
Stand on my side.

lines.zh: 这里的热对我们都还好
lines.en: The heat here suits us both.
I no longer need to put on airs.
We hold this bridge together.
Nothing needs saying.
Let us just stand here.
The lava will keep sounding.
This one is impossible to bite.
This cannot be bitten.
I drop it into the lava.
It has sunk.
I stuff gold nuggets into a rag pouch.
Still of no use.
I tuck it into my seam.
I used to melt these down.
Now I only hold them.
I stare at the gold nuggets without moving.
My eyes are fixed on you.
My eyes have brightened.
The bridge is only so wide.
You have nowhere to hide.
I brush against the fungus light on the wall.
This one will be hard.
You are not my kind.

lines.zh: 我的甲很重,但我不在乎
lines.en: My armour is heavy, but I do not care.
Gold cannot stop me.
Then I should act.

lines.zh: 你听见黑石的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear the blackstone?
That is me walking.
The far end of the bridge is blocked.
I have no retreat, and neither do you.
I follow you toward the middle of the bridge.
One foot back from you, one in from me.
Every step here is narrow.
My armour scrapes the wall.
The hot wind covers my sound.
You have reached the edge.
Lava is below.
I have no need to run.

lines.zh: 下界的同化猪灵，走这条路。
lines.en: A Nether assimilated piglin walks this way.

lines.zh: 我在等你自己退到尽头
lines.en: I wait for you to back to the end.
Nether fungus ate me first.
Two more steps and I am there.
I raise my hand.
My armour scrapes out sparks.
My hand comes down.
The gold armour drives you far back.
The blow numbs my arm.

lines.zh: 我金甲上长了别的东西，抓得更牢。
lines.en: Something new grew on my gold armor, and it grips harder.
My step cracks the blackstone.
You are pushed to the bridge's edge.
I shift back a step.
I can strike once more.
That one was truly heavy.
I was not supposed to be like this.
But my hand has already come down.

lines.zh: 我的金链子甩到你脸上。
lines.en: My gold chain whips across your face.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也站不稳
lines.en: That one left me unsteady too.
I press you against the railing.
I stand up at the edge of the lava.
There is another colour on my gold armour.

lines.zh: 岩浆的光照在我的獠牙上。
lines.en: Lava light glints on my tusks.
I hear something on the bridge.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向看，下界的同化体都在动。
lines.en: I look that way; the assimilated in the Nether are stirring.

lines.zh: 我记得这里原本有交易
lines.en: I remember there used to be trade here.
Now there is only hot wind.
I touch my face once.
This is not entirely me.
I walk slowly onto the bridge.

lines.zh: 黑石在我脚下发出声响
lines.en: The blackstone sounds under my feet.
Lava flows below.
My armour glows in the heat.
I land hard on blackstone.

lines.zh: 这里的水比岩浆还难熬
lines.en: The water here is worse than lava.
The blast throws me into the wall.
An arrow is lodged in my seam.

lines.zh: 那股力量穿过甲打进来
lines.en: That force passed through my armour.
There is little to eat in the Nether.
Lightning strikes my gold armour.
There is no blackstone to stand on.
